days.label: Monday
days.text: Monday's lineup is all evening. The Forever 38 crew takes a table at Trivia Mondays at Black Flannel [MEETUP] in Essex Junction at 6, and at 6:30 the monthly Collage Collective gathers at Expressive Arts Burlington on Flynn Avenue to cut, paste and create, by donation, with beginners welcome. Also at 6:30, Laura McPeake leads a drop in meditation class [MEETUP] at the Friends Meeting House on North Prospect Street, with simple guided meditations aimed at quieting busy thoughts. Violinist L. Shankar , one of the pioneers of East West music, who has played with Frank Zappa and Peter Gabriel, brings his 10 string double violin to the Higher Ground Showcase Lounge with doors at 7. Out in Shelburne, Chest Fever, billed as the official revival of The Band, performs The Last Waltz among the vines at Shelburne Vineyard from 7 to 10, rain or shine.

days.label: Tuesday
days.text: Tuesday's rain makes it a day for indoor plans. From noon to 5, the Colchester-Milton Rotary hosts a Red Cross blood drive at Our Lady of Grace in Colchester, with homemade baked goods after and a $15 e-gift card for every donor (book with the code CMROTARY). At 5, Fletcher Free Library hosts Writing for Healing , an hour of meditation, writing and Gateless feedback with snacks provided, and the Chamber & Economic Development of the Rutland Region brings its October mixer to Allen Pools & Spas in Williston from 5 to 7, benefiting Making Strides Against Breast Cancer. The Vermont Figure Drawing Collective draws from rotating models at Karma Bird House from 6 to 8, all skill levels welcome and no tickets needed. At 7, Dad Guild runs its open gym basketball at the Mater Christi School gym, Denver bluegrass quartet Magoo , whose debut album features Sam Bush on fiddle, plays the Higher Ground Showcase Lounge with doors at 7, NYU sociologist Lisa M. Stulberg talks with performer Kat Redniss about her book How to Win a Culture War at Phoenix Books, free with RSVP, and Kyle Stevens and Joe Friday play the Monkey House in Winooski with no cover. Queen City Brewery posted a Knot Knite for Tuesday too, so come do stuff with yarn. Partizanfilm screens Dead Media at 8:20, Joseph Scrimshaw's horror comedy about a haunted DVD and a movie night that won't die, and Jon McBride's Big Easy Tuesdays brings free jazz to The 126 at 9.

days.label: Wednesday
days.text: Wednesday is our first week of Pick-up Basketball [MEETUP] indoors at UVM's Gutterson Fieldhouse, from 5:30 to 7:30, with a $12 day pass at the Campus Rec front desk in the Gucciardi Fitness Center, so come get some runs in. Earlier in the day, voters can meet outside City Hall on Church Street between 9:30 and 11 to drop off their ballots together , and Vermont Womenpreneurs gathers women business owners at Deep City for its monthly Biz Buzz at 9:45. Martin and Chris Kratt bring Wild Kratts Live 2.0 to the Flynn at 3:30 and 6:30, and seats are limited. At 5, wildcrafter and folk herbalist Broni Grala leads a Farm to Medicine Cabinet herb walk through medicinal plants at Shelburne Farms, Vermont Cider Lab in Essex Junction hosts a dog friendly Yappy Hour for VEG Cares with live music from 6, and Doma Bar on Pine Street gets its weekly All-Inclusive Dyke-Tacular going, an LGBTQ+ listening party with dancing. Runners can head out on an easy out and back 5K from 1st Republic [MEETUP] in Essex Junction at 5:30.

days.label: Wednesday
days.text: Wednesday evening keeps going. At 6, Lama Rod Owens gives a public Dharma talk and meditation at the O.N.E. Community Center, the Boardroom hosts cribbage [MEETUP] for all experience levels, and Mesmer Kava's BYO Book Club has no assigned reading, just bring whatever you're into. At 6:30 the Architecture + Design Film Series screens Good Work: Masters of the Building Arts at Contois Auditorium, and the Ward 1 NPA at the Friends Meeting House hears from Burlington Parks on the city's new Open Space Plan before a Q&A with Chittenden-15 House candidates Ben Bosley, Brian Cina and Troy Headrick. At 7, punk band Prince Daddy & The Hyena plays the Higher Ground Showcase Lounge, Chuck Wendig and Delilah Dawson talk about their new books The Calamities and Monstera at Phoenix Books, and the Queen City Ghostwalk's waterfront tour leaves from Union Station. UVM Theatre opens Annie Baker's The Aliens at the Royall Tyler Theatre at 7:30, with performances through Sunday, Partizanfilm shows the 1978 Invasion of the Body Snatchers at 8 before it closes for HVAC work from Oct. 16 through Oct. 29, and Hotel Vermont's weekly Jazz Night with Ray Vega runs from 8:30 to 10:30.

days.label: Thursday
days.text: Thursday we're teaming up with South Burlington Rec's Social Pulse group for Ali T Live at J Ski's [MEETUP] , a free indoor show from 7 to 9 at J Ski's on Main Street with free snacks and pizza while they last and a cash bar, so come hang out with us. The day starts at 7:30 AM with Braver Angels ambassador Mary K. Dennison on courageous citizenship at a Rotary club meeting at 185 Market Street in South Burlington, and the VermontBiz2Biz Expo at the DoubleTree opens its exhibit hall to the public from 8:30 to 3, alongside a Senator Welch business breakfast and the Vermont Business Growth Awards luncheon. At 5, YOURstory gathers women in midlife for a free story circle at the South Burlington Public Library, with just 13 seats so reserve ahead, Out in the 802's LGBTQ+ happy hour [MEETUP] meets at Lincoln's, the speakeasy up the alley by Red Square, and Adventure Dinner throws a free Pumpkin Fest pop-up at its Clubhouse on the edge of Winooski and Colchester until 9, costumes encouraged. The Flynn's Art of Community Storytelling workshop starts at 6 with no writing experience needed, and at 6:30 New York standup Kendall Farrell , a former Vermont's Funniest Comedian winner, plays the Vermont Comedy Club while UVM's Luis Vivanco tells the story of When the Bicycle Came to Vermont at Fletcher Free Library, free with RSVP. Déjà Rêvé Actors Guild opens the second weekend of Venus in Fur at Off Center at 7 with a cast and crew talkback after, Don Mahogany hosts Third Thursday Trivia at Butter Bar at 7, and the Buena Vista Orchestra , with players from the Buena Vista Social Club and AfroCuban All Stars, takes the Higher Ground Ballroom stage at 8.
